_why: NIGHT33 builder R (design.n33.kit33 swaps n32-spire for this file): Tools/night/gen-n33-spire.cjs = gen-n32-spire.cjs. LEVEL 5, THE SPIRE (NIGHT32, builder F, DESIGN32.md card F, D-6; GG 2026-10-10: 'I also want the 5th stage to be made or the 5th level', 'the arenas are so boring', 'encourage the gameplay more'; earlier: 'a lot of the rooms to be a lot smaller and more action packed like ... ULTRAKILL', 'There always really needs to be a route that enemies can climb up'). The finale: a climb up a dusk tower that remixes each earlier level's verb, one per room, then a gauntlet, then THE CROWN. v1 threshold, v2 FOUNDRY FLOOR (two lava pools, a west wall lane over one, a deck), v3 ICE GLIDE (an ice sheet round a lava eye between two 2 m banks), v4 landing (health), v5 KILN VENTS (a lava flue: two aimed vents up to a 3 m gantry and a 5 m perch), v6 RING SPAN (three rings over a lava gap for the 2-charge grapple: ring, wall lane or island, ring, ground), v7 landing (health, checkpoint), v8 THE GAUNTLET (an ice plateau in a lava moat, a vent onto it, four rings round it, three waves), v9 THE CROWN (the boss room: a flat 44 x 44 m space builder C's round arena fills; plan boss id crown; with design.n32.boss5 off the room has no boss and clears on entry, Campaign24.StepFight). Generated by Tools/night/gen-n32-spire.cjs through Tools/night/n30-lib.cjs. Pars are estimates until the walk bot's medians (spire32). Web coordinates, metres: x east, y up, z SOUTH (the player walks north, -z).
